t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The color of the gnomes is cyclical. The value of the reward is between 1-9 mushrooms, so try to learn which color combinations give the best rewards over time.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will always appear in color pairs (red will always be an option next to yellow, green is a pair with blue, etc). It will be confusing at first, but try to identify the color pairs to start. The standard reward is 1-9 mushrooms, and the 5x bonus will be 5-45. Use the x1 rounds to identify which colors from each pair typically pay out more. If you notice that yellow gives few (or even 0) points, you know to favor red (or whatever color appears next to yellow in your experiment... they are ALWAYS in matching pairs). Sometimes, the pattern of which gnome will change slightly. If you notice that your favored gnomes are paying out less suddenly, the rules have probably temporarily reversed. I noticed that this never lasts long, though, and the safe bet is to:1.) get used to which colors appear together2.) get used to which gnome pays out more on average.Once you do that, then you will be able to adjust your strategy on the fly easily. Good luck :)
